How It WorksAboutPrivacy

Your game. Your data.

You can play the regular game without creating an account. Shared challenges use an anonymous browser profile, not a verified identity.

Updated October 16, 2026.

Saved on this device

Browser local storage holds game progress, selected matchups, picks, hints, Daily streaks, recent play history, optional side calls, creator challenge links, and preferences such as theme and reveal speed. On-demand league imports may also be cached in session storage. These browser saves are not automatically synced across devices.

Clearing this site's browser storage removes local saves and preferences. It does not by itself delete records already submitted to shared challenges or community tallies.

Shared challenges and community picks

When you choose a nickname, the server stores that nickname and a hashed session identifier. An HttpOnly session cookie identifies this browser for shared play. Submitted records can include your challenge, picks, hint use, final score, votes, and timestamps. Creator challenge titles and selected matchups are also stored.

People with a challenge link can see submitted nicknames and final scores after they finish and submit their own set. Rivalries compare completed sets shared by the participating browser profiles. Community screens show aggregate browser-profile votes, not verified unique people.

Profiles and challenge links expire after 30 days. That limits access; it is not a promise that expired database records are automatically erased. While your browser profile is still valid, the control below can delete its shared records. If its cookie has already been cleared or expired, this browser can no longer identify those records for self-service deletion.

Analytics and external services

The game loads Google Tag Manager and emits events such as first picks, completions, and sharing actions. The tags enabled in that container determine which additional measurement requests and cookies are used. This notice does not claim the game is tracking-free.

The site is published through Sites and served using Cloudflare infrastructure. External requests also include Google Fonts, Sleeper-hosted player images and team logos, and Sleeper API requests when you import a league. Those services receive ordinary request information, such as your IP address and browser details. Hosting providers may maintain their own operational logs.

The game API uses hashed network identifiers and request counters for rate limiting. Do not put personal or sensitive information into nicknames or challenge titles.

Remove your shared profile

This deletes the current browser profile's submitted scores and picks, community votes, and hosted challenge rooms, including submissions in those rooms. Other profiles and unrelated rooms are left alone. Your local Daily progress and streaks are not changed.

This cannot be undone. Your hosted challenge links will stop working.

The creator

The Contact link currently opens the creator's public GitHub profile, not a private support inbox. Do not share sensitive information in public feedback channels.
